# Time Changer

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Time Changer

## What it does

Makes you able to set a custom time.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/render/TimeChanger.java).
